subject: POC prompt batch delivery, eval ops playbook and owner confirmation
messages:
From: Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@nimbushealth.com>
To: priyom_das@redwood.ai
Cc: Jorge Silva <jorge.silva@nimbushealth.com>
Date: Sun, 20 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro / POC scoping call follow-up

Hi Priyom,

Thanks for the call today — Jamie and I appreciated the walkthrough. As discussed, we're keen to run a short POC that mirrors a small slice of our triage workflow: 1) classify inbound patient messages, 2) extract intent and key fields, and 3) surface suggested replies.

Quick clarifying points I promised to confirm:
- We can share a redacted export of ~3k past inbound messages (CSV) by end of next week.
- Our success bar: 85% classification accuracy on priority intents; extract fields precision > 90% on core entities; human-in-loop average latency below 400ms for 95th percentile.
- We're comfortable with a 3-week technical trial followed by a 4-week evaluation window.

Can you send a short checklist of what you need from us (file formats, schema, PI removal guidance) and who from your side will own data ingestion and eval metrics?

Cheers,
Aisha
Aisha Khan
Head of Clinical Ops, NimbusHealth

From: priyom_das@redwood.ai
To: Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, sean_gallagher@redwood.ai, Jorge Silva <jorge.silva@nimbushealth.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro / POC scoping call follow-up — checklist + owners

Hi Aisha — thanks for the clear notes. Short answer: yes, we can run the trial on the timeline you proposed. Below is an ingestion + eval ops checklist and proposed owner map. Please review and flag changes.

POC deliverables (technical):
- Ingest sample prompt set: CSV with columns [id, timestamp, channel, text, label(optional), redaction_level]. Prefer UTF-8, comma-delimited. Max file size per upload 200MB; we can accept multiple files.
- Ground-truth labels: optional for initial run; required for final evaluation (CSV with id,label).
- Eval metrics: classification accuracy, precision/recall on entity extraction, latency p95, and quality regressions vs baseline.
- Output format: JSONL for model responses with request_id, tokens_generated, top_logprobs(optional), and structured extraction fields.

Proposed owner map:
- Redwood ingestion & pipeline: Marissa Cole (solutions engineer) — marissa_cole@redwood.ai
- Evaluation / metric reporting: Sean Gallagher (Customer Success / Eval lead) — sean_gallagher@redwood.ai
- Commercial / contract / timeline: Priyom Das (you have me) — priyom_das@redwood.ai

Immediate asks from Nimbus:
1) Provide a redacted CSV export (3k messages) by 2027-06-25 with recommended column names above.
2) Confirm SOC2 redaction guidance or share a sample redaction script you use.
3) Share a primary technical contact for ingestion (Jorge?).

Attachments: poc-success-metrics-template.xlsx (we'll drop a workbook you can use for final scoring).

Next steps: once we have the CSV, Marissa will kick off a dry-run import and send a staging runbook (including credentials and upload method). Sean will prepare an evaluation dashboard template.

Best,
Priyom
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Jorge Silva <jorge.silva@nimbushealth.com>
To: priyom_das@redwood.ai
Cc: Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@nimbushealth.com>, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 23 Jun 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro / POC scoping call follow-up — checklist + owners

Priyom / Marissa —

I'll be the tech lead on the Nimbus side for ingestion. Quick answers:
- We'll export as CSV and remove PHI columns; we'll run your suggested redaction over our pipeline and share a sample before full push.
- Targeting upload on 2027-06-25 AM Pacific.
- We'll also include a small set (200 examples) with human-labeled intents to seed the first eval run.

Two operational notes:
1) Can Redwood support incremental uploads (append) so we can iterate on redaction before full 3k push?
2) For latency numbers we'll need a staging model that approximates production; can you confirm the model variant you'll run for the POC?

Thanks — Jorge
SRE Lead, NimbusHealth

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: Jorge Silva <jorge.silva@nimbushealth.com>, priyom_das@redwood.ai
Cc: sean_gallagher@redwood.ai, Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@nimbushealth.com>
Date: Thu, 24 Jun 2027 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro / POC scoping call follow-up — checklist + owners

Hi Jorge — incremental uploads are supported (we'll provide an S3 presigned path and a resumable HTTP endpoint). For the POC we'll provision a mid-sized latency-optimized variant (rwd-psi-2b-quant) as the default; if you need a lower-latency config we can enable a dedicated shard for the test (costs/time TBD).

Plan for this week:
- 06/25: Nimbus uploads redacted CSV (incremental OK) + 200 labeled seeding set.
- 06/26: Redwood ingestion dry-run + staging runbook (Marissa).
- 06/28: First staging run results: classification baseline + latency profile (Sean will share dashboard).
- 07/07: End of 3-week trial; final scoring window through 07/14.

I'll prepare a short runbook this afternoon with the S3 endpoint, accepted schema, and sample curl commands.

Marissa Cole
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Aisha / Jorge —

Received and verified the sample upload. Quick status and next steps:
- Ingestion: Marissa completed the dry-run and confirmed schema match. We ingested 3,021 rows to staging and validated redaction tokens.
- Eval: Sean published the staging dashboard at the Drive link and seeded the evaluation workbook (poc-success-metrics-template.xlsx) with preliminary classification baselines — classification accuracy on the labeled seed set is 78% (baseline model). Full metric computation will run after you provide the final labeling set at end of trial.
- Timeline confirmation: POC active now through 07/07, final scoring window 07/08–07/14.

Immediate asks for Nimbus this week:
1) Finalized labeled set (CSV) for scoring by 07/06.
2) Confirmation if you want us to enable a dedicated shard for improved p95 latency; note this will require a short approval and an estimated cost uplift.

We're tracking this in HubSpot (HS-4892) and I'll follow up with a short calendar invite for a 30-minute check-in on 07/01 to review staging results.

Thanks all — looking forward to the run.

Best,
Priyom
